title: PostgreSQL Architecture
description: Explore PostgreSQL process model, shared memory, and WAL.

data.text: PostgreSQL uses a process model with a postmaster and multiple backend processes. Shared buffers and WAL provide durability and concurrency.

data.caption: PostgreSQL process model
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    A[postmaster] --> B[backend]
    A --> C[WAL writer]
    A --> D[autovacuum]
    A --> E[background writer]

data.title: Tip
data.text: PostgreSQL 16 introduces parallel vacuum and incremental sort.

items.question: Does PostgreSQL use threads?
items.answer: Backend processes are operating system processes, not threads.

items.question: What is the WAL?
items.answer: Write-Ahead Logging ensures changes are logged before data files are modified.

items.question: What are CTID and xmin?
items.answer: CTID identifies a row physically. xmin tracks the inserting transaction ID.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Background processes handle maintenance and recovery.
